name: People's Democratic Republic of Algeria

areaKm2.note: asOf 2024. Surface area 2,381,740 km2 (AG.SRF.TOTL.K2); low is land area 2,381,740 km2 (AG.LND.TOTL.K2).

population.note: asOf 2025 (World Bank SP.POP.TOTL 47,435,312). Low -1% / high +1.5% for 2026 growth and estimate uncertainty.

activePersonnel.note: IISS Military Balance 2026 p.338 as quoted: 139,000 active. Paramilitary 187,200 (Gendarmerie, Republican Guard) excluded; CIA Factbook 2025 "estimated 200,000 active ANP incl. the National Gendarmerie".

trainedReserves.note: IISS Military Balance 2026: 150,000 reserves. High allows for the much larger pool of ex-conscripts.

supportPersonnel.note: Active 139,000 minus infantry P roles (60,000). Covers air force, territorial air defence forces, navy, crews and logistics.

mobilizationRatio.note: Analogy to Egypt/Morocco-type conscript mobilisation (3-8%); universal 12-month male service gives a large trained pool.

quality.note: Rubric 0.5-0.75: dense modern Russian network (S-300PMU2, S-400, Pantsir).

training.note: Rubric 0.5-0.75: conscripts (12 months) with a professional cadre; Sahel border operations.

commandQuality.note: Rubric 0.5: competent, Soviet-style staff; army is the core of state power.

cohesion.note: Rubric 0.5-0.75: national conscript army with strong institutional identity.

morale.note: Rubric 0.5: average; strong for home defence (independence-war legacy).

weapons.note: Anchor 9: Russian guided weapons, Kalibr on submarines, Kornet.

armor.note: Anchor 9: T-90SA with Shtora; no APS.

logistics.note: Anchor 9 minus: long desert distances, rail limited to the north.

isr.note: Anchor 9: Alsat satellites, Chinese MALE drones.

air.note: Anchor 9 plus: Su-30MKA, Su-34, first Su-57E.

gdpPerCapita.note: asOf 2025. GDP 603,097,891,526 2011 int$ (World Bank NY.GDP.MKTP.PP.KD rebased x 0.8005) / population 47,435,312 = 12,714 2011 int$. Range +/-10%.

gdp.note: asOf 2025. World Bank NY.GDP.MKTP.PP.KD (constant 2021 int$) 753,401,488,477 x 0.8005 (US GDP deflator 2011/2021) = 603,097,891,526 2011 int$. Range +/-10% for PPP benchmark uncertainty and the relative-price drift the rebase ignores.

milSpendShare.note: SIPRI via World Bank: 8.83% of GDP in 2025 (record budget), 7.97% 2024, 4.06% 2022 (low).

industrialShare.note: asOf 2025: industry incl. construction (and hydrocarbons) 34.8% of GDP (NV.IND.TOTL.ZS). Range +/-7% for oil-price swings.

annualCohort.note: asOf 2025. Males reaching military age per year = male population 24,186,841 x share of males aged 15-19 8.128% (SP.POP.1519.MA.5Y) / 5 = 393,204. Male population from SP.POP.TOTL.MA.IN. Males only (conscript-pool convention). Range +/-10% for single-year cohort variation.

ifv_apc.note: Educated guess. Fuchs 2 licence assembly (Rheinmetall Algeria, Khenchela).

roadKm.note: asOf 2026: 145,615 km total (117,000 paved of 127,000 in the breakdown).

railKm.note: asOf 2021: 4,000 route-km (World Bank IS.RRS.TOTL.KM). CIA Factbook 4,020 km (2019).

majorPorts.note: CIA Factbook 2024: 17 ports, 2 large + 1 medium = 3; 9 key ports named (Algiers, Annaba, Arzew, Bejaia, Mers El Kebir, Oran, Skikda...).

merchantTonnage.note: asOf 2025: not in the list of flags over 1,000,000 GT, so under ~1.6 million DWT; mid is an educated guess (Sonatrach LNG carriers, CNAN).

supplyRangeKm.note: Educated guess. Long internal desert lines to the Sahel border.

draftAnimals.note: Educated guess. Camels, donkeys, horses, mules; not from FAO data.

nuclearWarheads.note: Algeria is not listed among the nine nuclear-armed states in the FAS Status of World Nuclear Forces 2026 table.

homeDefense.note: Rubric 1.2: mountains, Sahara depth and strong population support; high 1.3 for the deep desert an invader is not adapted to.

notes: Peacetime snapshot (hostile relations with Morocco, Polisario host at Tindouf, Sahel instability). asOf 2025 economic data, 2026 order of battle. Population: everything inside ne:DZA (World Bank). Money in 2011 int$ via derived:ppp-rebase-2011. Counts from the Land Forces equipment list, Air Force and Navy tables (IISS-based); some unit wording on the list (S-300/S-400 "brigades") is ambiguous and converted with stated assumptions. ships_major = frigates. Infantry P-role splits are educated guesses (grade D). Paramilitary (187,200) excluded.
